caption: The drawing features a large two-story building with columns on its facade and a flag flying on its roof, primarily colored in light brown tones accented with gray, black, and hints of reddish hues on the flag. In front of the building, there is a white fence, and a tree with a curving trunk and green, brown, and orange leaves stands on the right side of the composition, partially overlapping the building. The background includes another structure, a church with a tall spire, rendered in a lighter, more faded manner using washes of gray and hints of yellow and red for the rooftops. The foreground and ground areas are shaded with soft greens and browns. The sky and open space around the buildings are left mostly blank with a light wash, giving an airy and open feeling to the composition.
title: House
